operating_notes.text: Atul discharges treated effluent into the estuarine zone via an approximately 4-km pipeline laid entirely within the estuary; a replacement pipeline is under installation with approvals obtained.
Board approved ₹90 Cr buyback from open market at max ₹7,500/share on Oct 23, 2026.
Price Waterhouse appointed as Statutory Auditors for 5 years starting from 2027 AGM.

timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹1,670.07 Cr (+15.0% YoY), net profit ₹211.12 Cr (+62.2% YoY).
On May 13, 2026, Atul launched three new crop protection products: Mylonis, Salix Gold, and Tikadis.
Sunil S. Lalbhai submitted the annual promoter share encumbrance declaration under Regulation 31(4) for FY26.

On October 16, 2026, Atul said accidental damage to its estuarine effluent pipeline caused a short release of treated effluent that met GPCB standards; discharge through the line is suspended pending repairs, and it expects no material impact.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹1,877.04 Cr (+21.0% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹155.72 Cr.
Atul Limited's board approved an open-market buyback of up to ₹90 Cr at a maximum price of ₹7,500 per share.
